<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Red Tiger 4</title>
<style>
/* Red Tiger 4 by Alaner-xs — https://uiverse.io/Alaner-xs/red-tiger-4 */
.input {
 border: 3px solid rgb(127, 170, 170);
 border-radius: 20px;
 background-image: linear-gradient(120deg,#3c3c3c,#585858);
 color: rgb(127, 170, 170);
 cursor: pointer;
 padding: 7px 12px;
 font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;
 font-size: 17px;
 transition: all 1s;
 max-width: 170px;
}

.input:focus {
 outline-color: rgb(127, 170, 170);
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<input type="text" name="text" class="input" placeholder="Type here...">

</body>
</html>
